page.layout: One title page, all lines centred. Title block at top, emblem (engraving with banner) in the middle, imprint and date at the foot.

main_text.l: in quibus nonnulli Ecclesiarum Belgicarum doctores
hodie à receptâ Doctrinâ dissentire videntur.

l.i: In usum futuræ Synodi Nationalis Latinè edidit, & collegit,

page.notes: Engraving between the title block and the imprint: an eagle standing on a rock or base, wings spread, with a banner held in its beak arching over it. The banner reads CONCORDIA (left side), RES PARVÆ (top), CRESCVNT (right side). Date printed as cIↄ. Iↄ. c.XVIII. Stamp of the Bayerische Staatsbibliothek München, the handwritten shelf mark at top left, the handwritten "4" at top right, and a red ink mark beside "BELGIO," were left out as not printed text.
